why_best: It transforms a basic functional click into a tangible moment of payoff, matching the tactile feedback expected from professional creative tools.
why_bad: An instantaneous, flat visual toggle would make the action feel weightless and unconsidered, failing to mark a pivotal moment of intent.
trap: A flawed execution will allow the radiating energy wave to dissipate too quickly, stripping the interaction of its sense of weight and resonance.
